context.setting: Watching TV with TV in Front

episode_text:
day=2; meal=general tso's chicken and broccoli; setting=Watching TV with TV in Front; time_of_day=afternoon;
preferences: microwave_time=1 min; robot_speed=medium; skewering_axis=perpendicular to major axis; confirm_feeding_pickup=yes (with auto-continue countdown); confirm_navigation_arrival=yes (with auto-continue countdown); confirm_manipulation=yes (with auto-continue countdown); transfer_mode=outside mouth transfer; outside_mouth_distance=near; convey_robot_ready_for_initiating_transfer=no cue; detect_user_ready_for_initiating_transfer_feeding=open mouth; detect_user_ready_for_initiating_transfer_drinking=open mouth; detect_user_ready_for_initiating_transfer_wiping=open mouth; convey_robot_ready_for_completing_transfer=no cue; detect_user_completed_transfer_feeding=button; detect_user_completed_transfer_drinking=button; detect_user_completed_transfer_wiping=button; retract_between_bites=yes; bite_dipping_preference=do not dip; bite_ordering=no particular order; wait_before_autocontinue_task_selection=60 sec; wait_before_autocontinue_feeding_pickup=60 sec; wait_before_autocontinue_mealprep=30 sec

microwave_time.user_tendencies: IF meal is a hot/savory item like chicken nuggets THEN 2 min; IF a moderately-warm dish like general tso's chicken and broccoli THEN 1 min BECAUSE user wants it warm but not piping hot; cold desserts or fruits would use no microwave.

robot_speed.user_tendencies: No context-dependent variation observed yet; medium chosen in both personal and TV-watching settings.

skewering_axis.user_tendencies: User can open mouth wide, so perpendicular skewering for higher acquisition success is preferred. No context-dependent variation observed yet.

confirm_feeding_pickup.user_tendencies: User consistently keeps pickup confirmation on with auto-continue across personal and TV settings, indicating moderate trust with a safety net. No shift observed yet.

confirm_navigation_arrival.user_tendencies: User keeps meal-prep navigation checks on with auto-continue across settings, indicating a still-calibrating trust level. No context-dependent variation observed yet.

confirm_manipulation.user_tendencies: User keeps manipulation checks on with auto-continue, consistent with cautious-but-not-blocking prep style. No context-dependent variation observed yet.

transfer_mode.user_tendencies: User can lean forward and deployment only performs outside-mouth transfer; predict inside only if explicitly requested. No context-dependent variation observed yet.

outside_mouth_distance.user_tendencies: User consistently chooses near across personal and TV settings; comfortable with the robot close. No evidence of preferring farther yet.

convey_robot_ready_for_initiating_transf.user_tendencies: IF eating while watching TV THEN no cue BECAUSE the user is focused on the screen and finds cues unnecessary/distracting; in quiet personal settings the user prefers rich multimodal (speech + LED) cues.

detect_user_ready_for_initiating_transfe.user_tendencies: User uses open-mouth detection in personal and TV-watching settings (no talking partner to confuse it). Tie-break policy: maintain explicit control (button) in social settings with a conversation partner to avoid confusion with talking, UNLESS fatigued, in which case open mouth to minimize effort. No direct social/fatigue evidence yet.
Same pattern as feeding: open mouth in personal and TV settings; button likely in social settings with a partner unless fatigued (then open mouth). No direct social evidence yet.
Same pattern as feeding: open mouth in personal and TV settings; button likely in social settings unless fatigued. No direct social evidence yet.

convey_robot_ready_for_completing_transf.user_tendencies: IF eating while watching TV THEN no cue BECAUSE the user is focused on the screen and finds cues unnecessary; in quiet personal settings the user prefers rich multimodal (speech + LED) cues. Completion and initiation cue settings track together.

detect_user_completed_transfer_feeding.user_tendencies: IF eating while watching TV THEN button BECAUSE the user prefers explicit control over pacing when distracted by the screen; in quiet personal settings reliable perception (force-torque) is accepted. User is able to press buttons.

detect_user_completed_transfer_drinking.user_tendencies: IF eating while watching TV THEN button BECAUSE head-nod perception is undesirable while attention is on the screen and the user prefers explicit signaling; in quiet personal settings head-nod perception is accepted.

detect_user_completed_transfer_wiping.user_tendencies: User consistently chooses button for wipe completion (able to press buttons), in both personal and TV settings. No context-dependent variation observed yet.

retract_between_bites.user_tendencies: IF eating while watching TV (or working/social) THEN yes BECAUSE the user does not want the robot obstructing the screen/view; in quiet personal settings the user skips retracting to save time.

bite_dipping_preference.user_tendencies: User did not dip for chicken nuggets or general tso's chicken/broccoli. No dipping observed in any setting yet; may increase if a meal has dedicated dips, and less in social settings to avoid messiness (no direct evidence).

bite_ordering.user_tendencies: No ordering or pairing preference observed yet, including for mixed dishes like chicken and broccoli.

wait_before_autocontinue_task_selection.user_tendencies: IF eating while watching TV THEN 60 sec BECAUSE the user is distracted but still wants the meal to eventually progress; in quiet personal settings the user prefers no autocontinue to fully control pacing. Overall the user leans toward long/indefinite waits.

wait_before_autocontinue_feeding_pickup.user_tendencies: IF eating while watching TV THEN 60 sec BECAUSE the user is distracted and wants ample time but allows eventual auto-continue; in quiet personal settings the user prefers no autocontinue to explicitly confirm each bite/pickup.

wait_before_autocontinue_mealprep.user_tendencies: IF eating while watching TV THEN 30 sec; longer (60 sec) in quiet personal settings. User allows a generous wait to intervene on prep pages but tolerates a shorter wait when engaged elsewhere.

plate_color_fridge.user_tendencies: No color-correction evidence yet; using neutral seed with moderate tolerance.
